shared_elements: human figure shown frontally/in profile with garment and headgear
band of repeated ornament (concentric circles / rosettes)
justification:
Both surfaces depict clothed human figures and include round disc-like motifs (concentric circles on A, rosette bands framing B), but that is about as generic as shared iconography gets. A shows a single massive frontal figure with a headdress and a few incised pendant/disc ornaments on its body, while B shows a horizontal procession of attendants leading a humped animal between ornamental borders 
their subject matter, composition and rendering conventions (blocky schematic incision versus modelled profile relief with drapery detail) do not correspond.
